issues.title: Ingest Johnson County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $16,825,928 across 26 funds. The largest: County General Fund ($7,441,056), County Road Fund ($4,656,281), Solid Waste Fund ($1,680,488). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.

issues.title: Reconcile County Collector (County General Fund)
issues.detail: Printed total is $235,830.09; the printed subtotals add to $231,415.09 (salaries $161,906.34, contract labor $6,500.00, matching $58,108.75, supplies $0.00, other services $4,900.00). The page image shows these numbers; the $4,415.00 gap is not explained on the page. Ask the county treasurer or clerk which figure is right, and how the adopted amount splits.
